request.description: ONE hanging woodland lantern per candidate, for Dungeon Matcher enchanted forest battle background. Native pixel-art isolated environment prop, front/very slight three-quarter view, NOT isometric. Canvas 48x64, whole silhouette padded at least 3 pixels. The actual lantern body is compact about22x28 pixels centered low in canvas, with a small top hanging ring and short 10px linked chain/rope up to a leafy dark wooden wall-branch bracket. Sturdy aged dark bronze/iron frame, simple domed roof, 3 warm amber/yellow glass panels with a tiny ivory light core, compact base finial. One or two olive leaves on the small overhead wooden bracket only, not a huge ivy bouquet. Match the supplied mockup lantern's cozy woodland shrine identity, useful beside the player portrait; avoid ornate gold luxury, skulls, gems, eyes, smile or character faces. Outline and shading discipline of supplied Rattlebones: hard native clusters, clear strong silhouette, broad calm planes, top-left material light, 2-3 useful shades per material. Luminous glass is warm but no soft halo or gradient, no blur, no AA, no dithering, no random particles, no ground, no background or text. Separate transparent sprite, all chain/bracket/lantern parts visible. Do not generate a scene or UI.

reference_images.usage: Use only the two hanging woodland lanterns in the TOP battle area as prop design/mood inspiration. Exclude all characters, portrait, gems, board, buttons and text.
